creation.musicLyricsGuide: Wirenta urugero n'ururimi muri uburyo bwawe. Shyira imigani mu tagi zishingiye hasi. Tanga {{instrumental}} ku magambo.
creation.setupAllDownload: Gukoporora no gushyiraho ibintu byose byoroshye
creation.setupStorage: Amadosiye yose hamwe: {{download}}. Reba: {{reserve}}. Ubugari bukenewe: {{required}}. Ubugari bukenewe ku diski: {{free}}.
creation.setupSpaceMissing: Habura {{missing}}. Ushobora gufungura umwanya cyangwa ushobora guhitamo indi diski ifite umwanya uhagije.
creation.setupTextNote: Ubundi buryo bwo gukoresha umwandiko gusa ku biganiro, kwandika, ibikoresho n'inyishu zitunganijwe. Gukuraho: ivyerekeye {{size}}. Bisaba kwibuka vyinshi kuruta . {{defaultModel}} kandi ntikora amashusho canke amajwi ubwayo. Inyishu zivugwa zikoresha ijwi ry’urutonde. Hitamwo ku bikorwa vy’inyandiko igihe ufise ubwonko buhagije. Suzuma inyishu z’ukuri ukoresheje amasoko.
creation.setupImageNote: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Q4_K_M yinjiza ishusho; Qwen3 yinjiza inyandiko n' VAE yinjiza ishusho ya nyuma. Gushyiraho ishusho y' ishusho, ureba neza, urusenda, ingamba n' igabanuka ry' uburebure. Reba: 21:9, 4 ingamba n' igabanuka ry' ishusho.
creation.setupMusicNote: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo gitanga imusiko cyangwa ingano z'amuziki. Umplanya uhereza ibyerekeye; umusinzi 2B Q4_K_M ushyira imusiko, umusinzi w'amagambo ukoresha incamake kandi VAE ugaragaza amuziki wa stereo 48 kHz. Shaka igihe, uburyo bw'amuziki, ingano, amagambo, rurimi, ingano n'ikigero. Icyo twumvisha: 30 igihe, ingano itanu, WAV 24-bit kandi ikigero cy'ubwitonzi.
creation.setupVideoNote: Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B Q4_K_M ikora amashusho avuye ku nyandiko. Rekozwe: 5 s, 21:9 na 16 FPS. Gushyiraho igihe kirekire, frame rate, resolution, steps na seed. Ibirindiro bito bishyira hamwe amashusho make; amakosa agaragara ni ashoboka. · MP4: Python + imageio-ffmpeg.
creation.setupAllNote: Iyinjiza n'ishyira mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga a mamodoka asabwa: LFM3-Omni + mmproj ku nyandiko, Qwen3-Embedding Q8_0 ku gushakisha mu ndimi nyinshi (CPU ku murongo), FLUX.2 Klein 4B n'ibigize byayo ku gutunganya amashusho, Real-ESRGAN ×2/×4, ACE-Step ku myandikire (Instrumental ku murongo), na Wan2.1 ku videwo. Igenzura ibiro by'inyandiko, ubuso bwa diski n'ibibazo bijyanye n'ividewo. Iyinjiza n'ibarurishamibare bisigaye bihari.
creation.videoDurationNote: Videwo z’igihe kirekire zikorwa hakoreshejwe amashusho make. Ibice byahinduwe bishobora kugaragara, kandi gusubiramo bishobora gufata igihe kirekire.

Videwo ikoresha Diffusers. CPU/GPU amatora ni atandukanye ku mucoder na igitanga ishusho mu mashini zishingiye ku bikoresho.

creation.cloudTimeout: Igikorwa cya cloudi nticyaba cyarangiye mu gihe giteganywa. Reba imiterere yacyo ku mutangabuhamya mbere yo gutangira ikindi gikorwa gifite agaciro.
creation.adobeCredentials: Adobe Firefly ikeneye ikimenyetso cy’uburenganzira bw’ubwikorezi n’indangamuntu y’umukiriya x-api-key mu mikorere y’umutanga.
creation.catalogNote: iyi Porogaramu ikoresha a list of maintained models. Refreshing it does not validate the key or your account access. No paid generation is used to test credentials.
creation.ggufImageModel: Umurongo wa Diffusion (GGUF or compatible Safetensors)
creation.ggufNote: Guhitamo imodoka yo gukwirakwiza, encoder y'inyandiko na VAE bitandukanye. Kuri FLUX.2 Klein 4B, ukoresha encoder Qwen3-4B hamwe na GGUF variants. Amadosiye NVFP4 ashyigikiwe ni yateguwe rimwe na Python na PyTorch mu cache ya compatibility; originals stay unchanged. This needs extra disk space and RAM. On Windows, Novera includes and manages the engine automatically. Auto uses available hardware; CUDA needs a CUDA build. Distilled Klein normally uses 4 steps and CFG 1. No weights are downloaded.
creation.ggufWrongModel: iyi GGUF ifite a Umwandiko Encoder. Guhitamo in the encoder field and choose a separate diffusion model in the image field.
creation.nativeNote: NVFP4 ya Native CUDA: Inyandiko z'FLUX.2 Klein 4B, encoder ya Qwen3-4B GGUF na VAE ya FLUX.2 Safetensors. Ikeneye Blackwell (RTX 50 series cyangwa ikenewe), Python, CUDA PyTorch na ibyemezo by'NVFP4. Teko tekoresha gusa. Icyo kintu cy'ubwoko butari cyemejwe kigaragara neza; koresha stable-diffusion.cpp kugira ngo ube mu cyubahiro. Aribaho ingano ya BF16 diffusion cache. Novera isoma Qwen ata guca ahandi, ivuye muri dosiye ya GGUF.
creation.deviceNote: Ibyo bice bifite ibyiciro by'ibikoresho bisanzwe. Auto ikoresha hardware ihari; native NVFP4 buri gihe ikeneye GPU bihuye neza kugirango ikoreshe GPU encoding igihe VRAM ihari. Qwen ku CPU ishobora kurinda VRAM ariko encoding igenda gato. Qwen ku GPU ikoresha layer offload. In stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto follows the selected engine; forcing CUDA requires a CUDA build.
creation.totalTimeHint: Igihe cyose kirimo gufungura, gukoporora, gutunganya, gutegereza mu kirere, gukuraho no gusiga. Gutunganya gusa bigaragara mu buryo bwihariye iyo ikoranabuhanga ribigaragaza.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: Gusobanura GPU, ikoresho cy'encoding cy'Qwen3-4B kuri CPU, 4 ingufu, CFG 1. Byakoreshejwe kuri Windows n'ibyo by'Vulkan; urugendo n'ubwihariye bishobora guhinduka bitewe n'ubwoko bw'ibintu byawe.
creation.seedNote: Amashusho yo mu karere gusa. Gereranya n’ico kigereranyo kimwe be n’ivyo ushizeho.
creation.imageResolutionMax: Igaragaza cyane mu Novera: 2048 × 2048 px Ububiko buhagije bukenewe.
creation.upscaleNote: Nyuma yo kwinjiza. Bisaba Python/PyTorch. Isohoka rinini: ×2 4096 × 4096, ×4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Gutegura no gusuzuma iby’ibanze by’ibanze mu Novera · Amagenzura.
creation.sizeAutoNote: Guhindura ishusho bihindura ishusho y'ishusho isanzwe. Ishusho ikoresha inshuro nyinshi za 16, kugeza kuri 2048 px.
creation.setupTextNvfp4Note: Uburemere bwa NVFP4 bwo guhitamwo, kuri GPU ya NVIDIA Blackwell yamenyekanye canke iyiyikurikira, ifise nibura 4.5 GiB ya VRAM. Kugira ukoreshe ubu buremere muri Novera, ububiko bwose bwa moderi butegerezwa kubanza guhindurwa bukaba NVFP4 GGUF ihuye, hanyuma bugasuzumwa. Guhindura ubu bubiko ntibiragenzurwa kuri iyi checkpoint. Dosiye ya Safetensors ihujwe ntishobora kwinjizwa n'imoteri yubatswe muri porogarama. Q8_0 ni yo iguma isabwa kuko yiteguye gukoreshwa. Ububiko bukenewe buravana kandi n'uburebure bwa contexte.
creation.setupOmniNote: Ivyategekanijwe kuri mudasobwa no kuri telefone ngendanwa. Igishushanyo gikomeye c'inyandiko, amashusho n'amajwi, hakoreshejwe ibisabwa {{projector}} dosiye. Gukuraho: ivyerekeye {{size}} ku madosiye yose. Hitamwo kugira ngo ukoreshe uburyo bwinshi bwo gukora. Ijwi riranga bivana n’ibarabara n’imoteri. Igihe kirekire gikoresha ubwonko bwinshi.

memory.manual: Gusanzwe · amakuru y'amodeli y'uburyo bw'uburyo bw'uburyo
memory.autoNote: Ifungura amashusho ku bushake kandi ifungura amashusho atakoreshwa nyuma y'uko akazi gakora karangiriye.
memory.manualNote: Inyandiko, ishusho n'ividewo bishobora gukoreshwa hamwe mu biganiro bitandukanye niba RAM/VRAM bibikora. Imodoka zishobora kubura ububiko bw'amaderese.

instructions.textDefault: Niwe uri Novera. Asubiza neza, mu buryo bwizewe no mu magambo make mu rurimi rw'umukoresha. Gukurikiza inzitizi zabo, gusuzuma ibimenyetso by'ingenzi igihe bishoboka no kuvuga ibitazwi.
instructions.imageDefault: Gukurikiza iby’ibanze, imyambarire n’imirongo y’ishusho. Gukoresha ishusho igaragara neza, izuba rihagije n’ibice by’ingenzi. Kubungabunga ibimenyetso by’ishusho; kwirinda itandukaniro n’ibice bitari ngombwa. Gushyiramo amagambo gusa igihe bisabwa.
instructions.videoDefault: Gukurikiza umuti, umwihariko n’igihe bigusaba. Gushyiraho ibisubizo, ibikoresho n’izuba mu buryo bwiza mu mashusho yose. Gukoresha imikorere myiza n’ibikorwa by’ikamera bigenzurwa. Guhagarika ihindagurika ry’ishusho, ihinduranya ry’ishusho n’amagambo atagenewe.
